description_en: Creates a digital human training task and configures the basic information and training material information for the digital human
description_zh: 本接口用于创建数字人训练任务，配置数字人基础信息与训练所需要的素材信息等
name: CreateAvatarTrainingJob

parameters.help_en: The name of the digital human. The name can be up to 7 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 数字人名称，不多于 7 个字符
parameters.name: avatar_name

parameters.example: This is a digital human used for a specific scenario.
parameters.help_en: The description of the digital human. The description can be up to 1000 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 数字人描述，不多于 1000 个字
parameters.name: avatar_description

parameters.help_en: The type of the digital human
parameters.name: avatar_type

parameters.help_en:
The thumbnail URL.
After training succeeds, the thumbnail is uploaded to this address.
The URL must be a valid public OSS URL under the current user.
The URL can be up to 512 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
缩略图 URL
训练成功后会将缩略图上传到这个地址中
必须是用户下合法的 OSS 公网 URL
不多于 512 个字符
parameters.name: thumbnail

parameters.help_en:
The media asset ID of the avatar image. The ID is 32 characters in length.
If you subsequently call SubmitAvatarTrainingJob to submit the training, this field is required.
The image must have equal width and height
parameters.help_zh:
头像图片的媒资 Id，长度为 32 个字符
如果后续调用 SubmitAvatarTrainingJob 提交训练，则本字段为必填
图片素材要求宽高相同
parameters.name: portrait

parameters.help_en:
The media asset ID of the training video.
The ID is 32 characters in length.
Supported formats: mp4, mov, and webm.
The duration of the material must be between 5 minutes and 15 minutes.
The resolution of the material must be 1920 × 1080 or 1080 × 1920.
If you subsequently call SubmitAvatarTrainingJob to submit the training, this field is required
parameters.help_zh:
训练视频媒资 ID
长度为 32 个字符
支持 mp4，mov，webm 格式
素材时长需在 5 分钟到 15 分钟内
素材分辨率需为 1920 * 1080 或 1080 * 1920
如果后续调用 SubmitAvatarTrainingJob 提交训练，则本字段为必填
parameters.name: video

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the training video supports a transparent channel.
<notice>Make sure that this setting is consistent with the submitted training video. Otherwise, the synthesized digital human may be abnormal.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
训练视频是否支持透明通道
<notice>请严格确认当前设置与提交训练视频情况一致，否则合成数字人可能会异常></notice>
parameters.name: transparent

JobId.description_en: The ID of the digital human training task

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
